A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SDGAD research. Their complete main texts, figures, tables, equations, and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching material across relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: V1 reports original evaluations on six datasets, component ablations, hyperparameter studies, and score-distribution analyses in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: V2 retains those empirical results and adds threshold experiments comparing SDGAD with TCL on Wikipedia and UCI.

M1.justification: Residual encoding, representation restriction, bi-boundary optimization, the combined objective, and anomaly scoring remain unchanged. Equation 6 introduces equivalent shorthand; newly specified flow implementation details do not establish a changed method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same six datasets, real and synthetic anomaly types, unseen structural-anomaly evaluation, and S1–S3 supervision settings. The new threshold analysis reuses Wikipedia and UCI.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in all matched benchmark and ablation tables. The new threshold analysis compares against TCL, which already participates in the corresponding score-distribution comparisons.

E3.justification: New Appendix G evaluates test thresholds 0.01, 0.1, 0.3, and 0.5 using F1, TPR, and FPR, with checkpoints selected by validation F1 at 0.5. Existing protocols remain unchanged; Appendix C's newly stated default F1 threshold is additional documentation.

E4.justification: Appendix G adds a focused threshold-sensitivity analysis for SDGAD and TCL on two datasets. Existing component ablations, hyperparameter studies, loss-weight analyses, and distribution visualizations are retained, including studies moved from Appendix D into Section 5.5.

E5.justification: Appendix C retains the same five-independent-run, mean-and-standard-deviation reporting policy. No new seed, repeat-count, significance-test, or uncertainty-estimation procedure is specified; the added threshold tables provide point estimates without separate uncertainty information.

E6.justification: All ten original tables retain their data after matching renumbered tables. New Tables 7–10 add threshold results: on UCI, SDGAD reports F1 0.444444, TPR 1, and FPR 0.002298 at every tested threshold, while TCL reports zeros. These are additional results, not improvements over v1 under changed training.

T1.justification: New Appendix D derives per-batch computational complexity for the baseline and SDGAD, accounting for encoder calls, projection, and flow blocks. The existing error-bound propositions and proofs in Appendix E.2 remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same principal contributions: an encoder-agnostic framework combining residual encoding, restriction, and bi-boundary optimization for detection under limited supervision. The new analyses do not redefine these central claims.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 adds reasons for choosing normalizing flows. Appendix G interprets threshold responsiveness, explains high false-positive rates at low cutoffs, and discusses dependence on validation-based checkpoint selection. Appendix A's substantive limitations and future directions remain the same.

D1.justification: V2 adds a public code hyperlink, explicitly documents the 0.5 F1 threshold for existing validation and test evaluations, and specifies six coupling blocks with two-layer fully connected subnetworks and analytic log-determinants. These are disclosures; the PDFs do not establish implementation changes or verify repository availability.

R1.justification: Section 4.2 explicitly credits Zhang et al. (2024) for the two-hypersphere construction and distinguishes SDGAD through its dynamic, non-i.i.d., end-to-end setting. V2 also adds Hua et al. (2026), BAG; the Kong reference receives a publication update.

P1.justification: The hyperparameter discussion moves from Appendix D to Section 5.5, with appendices reorganized around new complexity and threshold sections. Localized prose revisions, equal-contribution and publication information, and acknowledgements are added; most narrative remains unchanged.

P2.justification: V2 adds four threshold tables and rearranges existing tables and figures. The original hyperparameter Table 5 becomes main-text Table 4, and other displays are redistributed and renumbered. Existing figure graphics and retained table contents are unchanged.

improvement.justification: V2 improves transparency through the explicit F1 cutoff, flow implementation details, code link, complexity analysis, and clearer attribution of the hypersphere idea. Threshold experiments add useful evidence, although Appendix G overstates consistently favorable trade-offs: Tables 9–10 show lower SDGAD F1 than TCL at thresholds 0.01 and 0.1 on Wikipedia. The gains are therefore limited, with the central method, benchmark evidence, and existing proofs unchanged.
